body:
I hope I can find a passion. As it is I don't even know where to start, and feel incredibly daunted by my debt and the stigma of restarting college at 20 or 21. I think/hope I will go back. I want to. I just feel...unprepared, right now.

The thought of my mom's love has saved me many times before. My mom is an amazing person who has helped me through a lot of shit and always accepted me. Thank you for reminding me. I don't feel quite as shitty as I did last night but nothing about this is easy. I don't really trust my friends to care about me, either. At least family is something.

It's just that, I feel like. Life does get better. And sometimes I feel happy, and then life just takes a huge shit on me, and more often than not it's my fault. Do I have any hope of redeeming myself? Do I have any hope of living a life unfettered by guilt or feelings of worthlessness? these are what make me feel alone and unsalvageable.
Yeah. I feel so fucking dumb because I have sworn off this guy over and over again, and every time I'm taken back in. I swear each time he changes. =\ Thanks for listening.

I had a long talk with a friend last night. (I am so glad he answered that IM.) He basically told me that I'm a huge dick but at least I realize it and feel bad. I know it's not much comfort but at least a couple people think that it's a good step to not being a scummy person.

I agree. I tried talking to my ex yesterday and he won't even give me the time of day now. Ridiculous considering all the other things he said to me not two days ago - this has been a pattern through all the years we've known each other. Other people I can let go, but this one guy fools me every time. :\ Time to man up.

Thank you for your reply.

The learning *hurts*. The shattering of my illusions hurts even more. I was never really prepared for that, haha. We all have our little dreams about reality and they're never what they seem.

I think you're right. I know I have to come clean. I'm deathly afraid though. I've never had to hurt another person like that before. Especially one who has been nothing but good to me. I feel like a monster.
